title: Bakery
content: Last night I was at a bakery again doing the same thing which is looking at amazing cakes and pastries but never being able to choose what I want / taking too long. It’s always really busy too and I feel like everyone’s watching me waiting for me to hurry up and choose. Anyone else have an experience with a bakery ? I feel like it’s somewhere close to mall world but I can’t remember it clearly enough.
